verdict.rationale: Square's docs state that merchants can accept contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets in person via Tap to Pay on iPhone. They also describe processing payments on Square hardware, and the Terminal API covers in-person checkout flows with signature capture. A community comment describes Square as a 'card in the reader + pin entered' solution, which implies chip support. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of chip/EMV insertion acceptance, Google Pay named explicitly, and hands-on corroboration of wallet acceptance on Square hardware.
